messages:
deploy-bot: Starting region rollout -> US (us-west/us-east). Version: 1.3.5-rc2. Canary=5% for 15m. Change window 02:00-04:00 UTC. Pin EU to 1.3.4 until green. Notes: autoscale policy will attempt +2 pods on sustained 70% GPU. Please ACK and run capacity checks.

maya: ACK. Running capacity check on US canary pool now. Will post peak GPU % and tail latency.

tom: Holding APAC until US canary and EU pin look good. Noted prior APAC queue spikes at seq_len 2048.

jordan: Paste of quick checks:
```
# k get pods -n inference-us -o wide
inference-canary-1  Running  1/1  48m  80% GPU
inference-canary-2  Running  1/1  12m  62% GPU
# nvidia-smi --query-gpu=utilization.gpu,memory.used --format=csv
utilization.gpu [%], memory.used [MiB]
79 %, 11432 MiB
63 %, 10212 MiB
``` 
Tail latency (p50/p95): 35ms / 220ms (5% canary). No OOMs.

ops-sre: Suggest set fallback routing to dedicated-1 if latency exceeds 300ms for 5m. Also creating a short rollback runbook: rollback -> revert traffic to 1.3.4; scale canary down; clear KV cache. @maya please validate KV cache clearing steps.

maya: KV cache clear confirmed via endpoint /admin/kv/clear?env=canary - returned 200. Performing synthetic prompt tests (100q) -> pass rate 98%. Will keep monitoring.

deploy-bot: Canary reached 5% in US at 1765004391. Monitoring for 15m.

zach: Quick note — cost vs perf: 1.3.5-rc2 increases token throughput by ~7% but 3% higher GPU mem usage. If we see >10% mem we should drop batch size.

emily: EU pinned to 1.3.4 as requested. APAC rollout paused. Leaving note on release notes: "Pinned EU to 1.3.4 due to staging regression; US canary 5% on 1.3.5-rc2". I'll prep public changelog after full rollout.

tom: Observed a small spike at +10min mark in US canary (p95 -> 380ms) correlated with a background batch job. Ops scaled +1 gpu and latency recovered. Keeping watch.

maya: After 15m watch: p95 stabilized 210ms, no errors. Recommend proceed to 20% canary for US for additional 20m. Anyone object?

jordan: No objections from SRE side. Proceed.

deploy-bot: Rolling to 20% in US now. APAC still on hold; EU pinned. Will post final status after EU decision.

ops-sre: Adding note to incident channel: if any region crosses 500ms sustained for 10m, we'll trigger rollback to previous model and open an incident.

[reactions: :thumbsup: from maya, jordan, emily]
